# Spline glass scenes (self-hosted)

Drop exported `.splinecode` files here:

- `shield.splinecode`
- `bars.splinecode`
- `chat.splinecode`

Also vendor `@splinetool/runtime` as `runtime.js` (ESM) in this folder.

Until those files exist, [scripts/spline-glass.js](../../scripts/spline-glass.js) serves the SVG fallbacks in `images/glass/`.

**Rules**

- Do not embed `prod.spline.design` iframes (Klaro / Datenschutz).
- Confirm commercial Spline license before shipping WebGL on ritz-ai.solutions.
- Prefer Racing Green / Sage glass materials; orange only as accent.
